requirements.text: The library management system shall operate with a minimum uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books to maintain security.
The system shall limit simultaneous borrow operations to 5 per member to ensure safety and responsibility.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability and accountability.
The system shall notify members of overdue books within 24 hours via a secure and efficient method.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books to ensure proper disposal.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
